summary: Frontend-only verification of MapLogoBadge (Xaluca brand logo overlay) on every Leaflet map across the site. Tested 5 routes via Playwright at 1440x900: home /, /viajes, /marruecos, /cuando-viajar, and program detail /viajes/escapadas/desierto/programa_3n_4d. Verified data-testid='map-logo-badge' presence, visibility, top-right position (~13px offset), pointer-events:none, z-index:1000, and that it does not conflict with the Leaflet top-LEFT zoom controls. 4 of 5 pages pass; /cuando-viajar is missing the badge (component imported but never rendered).

ui_bugs.issue: MapLogoBadge is imported (line 4 of src/pages/WhenToTravelPage.jsx) but never rendered. The seasonal Leaflet map (line 769-817, wrapper has 'relative' class) shows NO Xaluca badge in the top-right corner. All other 4 tested pages render the badge correctly.

action_items: Add <MapLogoBadge /> as a sibling after </MapContainer> (line 817) inside the relative wrapper in src/pages/WhenToTravelPage.jsx so the climate/seasonal map shows the Xaluca logo top-right like every other map.
(Optional, pre-existing) Two React 'duplicate key' console warnings on home page: 'north-exp-[object Object]'. Object is being stringified into a key. Investigate the .map() that produces these keys.
Optional: verify mobile viewport (390px) renders the 40px badge without overlapping legends/cards.
critical_code_review_comments: WhenToTravelPage.jsx imports MapLogoBadge but does not use it — dead import + missed feature. Add <MapLogoBadge /> after </MapContainer>.

MapLogoBadge.jsx is clean: pointer-events:none, z-[1000], absolute top-3 right-3, drop-shadow, aria-hidden. Re-used consistently across DayRouteMap (3 maps), MapSection, TripOverview, TripRouteMap, ToursRegionMap, JuegoPage, QueVerEnMarruecosPage, MoroccoLandingPage.
Two stale React 'duplicate key' warnings ('north-exp-[object Object]') indicate an object is being coerced into a key string somewhere on the homepage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified positions/visibility via Playwright bounding boxes. On /viajes the badge sits at (right_offset=13px, top_offset=13px) of [data-testid='viajes-region-map-canvas'], computed style pointer-events:none and z-index:1000. After main agent adds <MapLogoBadge/> in WhenToTravelPage.jsx, re-run the same Playwright script counting [data-testid='map-logo-badge'] on /cuando-viajar — expected count >= 1 and visible.
rca of the issue: On /cuando-viajar the MapLogoBadge default import was added (line 4) but the JSX <MapLogoBadge /> was never placed next to <MapContainer> in the seasonal map (around line 817 in src/pages/WhenToTravelPage.jsx). The parent wrapper already has 'relative' positioning at line 769, so adding the component as a sibling after </MapContainer> will fix it instantly. Reproduction: open /cuando-viajar, scroll to 'Mapa estacional / Cada color, una estación' section — top-right is empty; screenshot saved as .screenshots/cuando_map.png.
